The '''Braxant sector''' was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Planets in the Braxant [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Bastion/Legends|Sartinaynian]] ([[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]), final capital of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. The sector also contained [[Rimcee Station]] as and the resort [[The Edge of the Galaxy]].

==History==
During the events surrounding the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was governed by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra]]. At this time it was defended by the [[Braxant Sector Fleet]], a fleet including thirteen [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="SotP" />

Following Disra's duplicity in that crisis, the young [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Ephin Sarreti]] took his place.
